text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild pancytopenia (low leukocytes, erythrocytes, hemoglobin, platelets) with increased red cell distribution width, low neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages, and mild basophilia. Biochemistry and coagulation are within normal limits except for slightly low ALT. Findings may suggest bone marrow suppression or chronic disease; clinical correlation and further hematological evaluation are recommended.
